run_create_clevr_count_cli: run the CLEVR count dataset creation script with input and output paths via argparse CLI
download_clevr_dataset: download and extract the CLEVR_v1.0 dataset archive into a specified root directory
create_clevr_count_filelist: create a classification dataset filelist from CLEVR scenes by counting objects per image
get_argument_parser: get an argparse argument parser supporting input, output, and download flags for the script
process_clevr_splits: process train and validation splits of CLEVR to produce aligned image paths and count labels as numpy arrays
